_readme: Names for teams Spordle lists without one: teams from outside PCAHA (BCEHL zone teams, VIAHA Island teams, a few PCEHL opponents). Keyed by Spordle team id; used wherever Spordle leaves the name out. BCEHL names are from BC Hockey’s standings (stats.bchockey.net, same team ids). VIAHA names are matched on viaha.org by each team’s record, or by being the only team left in its division. PCEHL names are from our own game sheets. Filled in by hand; a team that isn’t here still shows as Unknown.
